content.simple_explanation: To learn Large Numbers Around Us, first understand the main idea, then identify supporting evidence/examples or steps, and finally apply the idea.
key_points: He visits the market regularly to buy seeds for his rice field.
During one such visit he overheard a conversation between Ramanna and Lakshmamma.
Ramanna said, “Earlier our country had about a lakh varieties of rice.
Farmers used to preserve different varieties of seeds and use them to grow rice.
So far, they have collected about a hundred indigenous varieties of rice seeds from different places.
You can also buy seeds from there.” You may have heard the word ‘lakh’ before.
